SELECT 
    e.id, 
    e.title, 
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'confirmed' THEN r.seats ELSE 0 END), 0) AS seats, 
    COALESCE(COUNT(t.id), 0) AS tags
FROM 
    events e
LEFT JOIN 
    registrations r ON e.id = r.event_id
LEFT JOIN 
    tags t ON e.id = t.event_id
GROUP BY 
    e.id, e.title
ORDER BY 
    e.id

SELECT 
        e.id, 
        e.title, 
        COALESCE(r.seats, 0) AS seats, 
        COALESCE(t.tag_count, 0) AS tags
    FROM events e
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT event_id, SUM(seats) AS seats 
        FROM registrations 
        WHERE status = 'confirmed' 
        GROUP BY event_id
    ) r ON e.id = r.event_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT event_id, COUNT(*) AS tag_count 
        FROM tags 
        GROUP BY event_id
    ) t ON e.id = t.event_id
    ORDER BY e.id

SELECT 
    c.id AS customer_id, 
    c.name, 
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status != 'void' THEN i.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS billed, 
    COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS paid
FROM 
    customers c
LEFT JOIN 
    invoices i ON c.id = i.customer_id
LEFT JOIN 
    payments p ON c.id = p.customer_id
GROUP BY 
    c.id, c.name
ORDER BY 
    c.id

SELECT 
    c.id AS customer_id, 
    c.name, 
    COALESCE(inv.billed, 0) AS billed, 
    COALESCE(pay.paid, 0) AS paid
FROM 
    customers c
LEFT JOIN 
    (SELECT customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN status != 'void' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS billed 
     FROM invoices 
     GROUP BY customer_id) inv ON c.id = inv.customer_id
LEFT JOIN 
    (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS paid 
     FROM payments 
     GROUP BY customer_id) pay ON c.id = pay.customer_id
ORDER BY 
    c.id
